title: FSM Ghost Transition — Illegal States Have No Escape
expected_root_cause: The 3-bit state register can encode values 3 through 7 which are not used by the design; the case statement has no default branch, so any illegal state results in next_state=X and the FSM permanently freezes.
description: A 3-bit state encoding for a 3-state machine (S0, S1, S2) has 5 unused encodings (3–7); an SEU or scan-chain glitch landing in those states leaves next_state as X and the FSM frozen.
success_log: Illegal state injection (state=3'h6): returns to S0 in one cycle.
